title: Faithfully flat base change reflects universal injectivity
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], and let $u:P\to Q$ be an $R$-linear map. Let $S\otimes_Ru:S\otimes_RP\to S\otimes_RQ$ be the scalar-extension map with the $S$-action on the first factor [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Then $u$ is universally injective (for every $R$-module $L$, $L\otimes_Ru$ is injective) if and only if $S\otimes_Ru$ is universally injective as an $S$-linear map (for every $S$-module $T$, $T\otimes_S(S\otimes_Ru)$ is injective).

source.place: Tag 05CK, lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective, applied to kernels after tensoring; equivalently the faithfully flat reflection used in Tag 05A5

proof.text: Assume first that u is universally injective over R, and let T be any S-module. Restrict scalars along R→S, so T is an R-module. Universal injectivity of u makes the R-linear map T tensor_R u injective. The cancellation isomorphism of [lem-trf-scalar-tensor-cancel-base-change] identifies T tensor_S (S tensor_R u) with T tensor_R u; on pure tensors this intertwining sends t tensor (s tensor p) to (s • t) tensor u(p). Conjugating by this isomorphism shows T tensor_S (S tensor_R u) is injective. Since T was arbitrary, S tensor_R u is universally injective over S.

source.place: Tag 05A5 proof, final faithfully-flat reflection argument with scalar-extension cancellation

proof.text: Conversely, assume S tensor_R u is universally injective over S, and fix an arbitrary R-module L. Apply the hypothesis to the S-module S tensor_R L; thus (S tensor_R L) tensor_S (S tensor_R u) is injective. The distributivity isomorphism of [lem-trf-scalar-tensor-distrib-base-change] identifies this map, by its pure-tensor formula and the same formula for induced tensor maps, with S tensor_R (L tensor_R u). Hence the left tensor of L tensor_R u by the faithfully flat R-module S is injective. The reflection theorem [lem-trf-faithfully-flat-ltensor-injective-reflection] gives that L tensor_R u itself is injective. As L was arbitrary, u is universally injective over R.

source.place: Tag 05A5 proof, final sentence: faithfully flatness reflects universal injectivity after tensoring

proof.text: The two implications establish the stated equivalence. All tensor products use the first-factor scalar action specified in [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and the faithfully flat hypothesis is exactly [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].
